title: Chapter 280: Fierce Head-On Confrontation
content:
Chapter 280: Fierce Head-On Confrontation

The powerful mage from the Tianwai Human Race arrived at the predetermined position and began to cast spells in groups. Attack magic was quickly formed one by one, and launched an attack on the group of Zerg puppies who were struggling to block the charge of the Tianwai Human Race army.

Various magics such as earth, water, fire, wind, and light come on stage. Although the attack range of these magics is far inferior to that of large-scale battlefield magics, they are very effective in killing Zerg puppies and effectively support the alien army. attack.

"Boom boom boom...!"

Most of the 150,000 Zerg Destroyers have found a place to stay on the battlefield again. They continue to fire, providing fire support to the Zerg puppies ahead that are blocking the Tianwai human army.

Under the two large-scale battlefield magic attacks of the Tianwai Human Race, the Zerg Destroyers did not suffer any reduction in numbers. The careful preparations of the Tianwai Human Race were completely in vain.

However, the changes in the battlefield terrain caused by the two large-scale battlefield magics made many Zerg destroyers unable to find a place to stay for a while.

Above the position, there are huge criss-crossing cracks everywhere. Many Zerg saboteurs fell in and are now climbing back up.

The same is true for the other main battle units of the Zerg, and they need to find a place to stay again.

This position is no longer suitable for formation and combat, but the Tianwai Human Race army has already rushed out and is attacking in this direction. Now it is too late to move the position.

However, fighting in complex terrain, the Zerg will not suffer. If the Tianwai human army can really attack, this battlefield may still be used as a line of defense.

The firepower of the Zerg Destroyers resumed, and the casualties of the attacking troops from the Outer Terrans immediately increased.

However, the momentum of the Tianwai Human Race army has taken shape, and now with the support of various powerful magic spells from the powerful Tianwai Human Race mages, the Zerg puppies still cannot withstand their attack.

Wu Qing immediately upgraded all the remaining one-star Zerg Destroyers to two-stars.

Some two-star Zerg Destroyers that were in poor condition were also upgraded to three-star status.

When all Zerg Destroyers entered combat mode and completed a large number of upgrades, the attack firepower of 150,000 Zerg Destroyers was greatly enhanced!

The other Zerg main battle units, Zerg cockroaches and Zerg stealth spiders that had all emerged from the ground, all took the initiative and moved forward to assist the Zerg puppies in blocking the attack of the outer human army.

One hundred thousand Zerg stealth spiders have a longer attack range. They are the first to join the battle, blocking the forefront of the charge of the Tianwai human army.

Countless terrifying armor-piercing spikes continued to poke out from the ground, hindering the charge of the sharp-sword cavalry troops in the Tianwai Human Army. The Zerg puppies seized the opportunity and attacked in groups, successfully slowing down the advancement of the Tianwai Human Army.

The various powerful magics and various siege weapons of the Tianwai human army are also focusing their fire on the Zerg puppies at this location. The Zerg puppies that rush up will soon turn into light and disappear.

The Zerg Destroyer with enhanced firepower did not care about the damage of the Zerg puppy, and a large number of liquid fireball shells from the five-star Zerg Destroyer fell down.

"Rumble...!"

Magic explosions and artillery shell explosions, mixed with various battlefield noises, continued to echo at the forefront of the battle between the two armies.

A large number of Zerg puppies and alien human troops disappeared in this area!

The rapid entry of the Zerg saboteurs into the battle became the biggest obstacle to this large-scale offensive by the Tianwai human army.

The Tianwai Terrans have been attacking the main formation of the Zerg army in order to eliminate the Zerg Destroyers. The Zerg Destroyers are the Zerg troops that the Tianwai Terrans hate the most.

Most of the various deployments of the Tianwai Terrans give priority to the elimination of the Zerg saboteurs. Only when the Zerg saboteurs are eliminated can the battle of the Tianwai Terrans be easier to fight.

The deployment of the Zerg army basically revolves around the Zerg destroyers. As long as the Zerg destroyers are kept intact, no matter whether it is defense or offense, they will be able to do it with ease.

The Tianwai humans paid a heavy price and used two powerful battlefield magics, one of which was a specially enhanced version. In the end, they still failed to eliminate the Zerg destroyers.

The Tianwai human race decisively sent troops out of the city to fight, with the ultimate goal of wiping out the Zerg saboteurs from the ground.

As for the air, the Zerg's more than 500,000 air mobile troops, coupled with the powerful air defense force of millions of Zerg Hydralisks, make the limited air force of the Tianwai Terrans seem a bit weak.

When the one-point breakthrough tactic of the Tianwai human army didn't work, they began to lengthen the front line and adopt a multi-point advance tactic.

Several cavalry units of the Tianwai Human Race began to charge and break through from multiple positions. The infantry troops of the Tianwai Human Race followed closely behind and launched the fiercest attack!

These Tianwai human troops who left the city never thought about going back. Instead of retreating and being chased, they might as well go forward bravely and charge forward. Even if they end up falling on the way to the charge, it is worth it.

Millions of elite human troops from outside the world attacked desperately, and the Zerg army fought extremely fiercely even with the fire support of 150,000 Zerg saboteurs.

"Peng Peng Peng...!"

The ultra-long-range attack siege equipment in the 996th City of the Tianwai Human Race has completed maintenance and is firing again!

Because the humans outside the world discovered that all the Zerg Hydralisks were guarding the Zerg Destroyer positions, the attacks of the ultra-long-range siege equipment in the city no longer targeted the Zerg Destroyers, but also attacked the Zerg puppies who were blocking the attack. .

Siege machine shells with attack power comparable to that of a five-star Zerg Destroyer kept falling into the Zerg Puppies. The Zerg Puppies, whose strength had not yet reached the star level, disappeared in pieces.

The gap in strength between the two sides was too great, and the Zerg Puppies had no resistance at all.

Fortunately, the 100,000 Zerg Stealth Spiders were attacking underground, and various attacks on the ground could not hurt them at all, which allowed them to provide stable firepower output and become the backbone of defensive operations.

After the fierce attack of the Zerg Puppies was suppressed by the long-range firepower of the aliens, it would take a lot of time for the Zerg Destroyers and Zerg Stealth Spiders to destroy them, even if the elite troops of the millions of aliens stood still.

Without the resistance of the Zerg Puppies, the advancement speed of the alien army suddenly became faster!

Hundreds of thousands of Zerg cockroaches began to participate in the battle, and flames were sprayed out, and even the remaining Zerg Puppies were ignited!

The Zerg Zerglings handed over the frontal blocking to the Zerg Cockroaches and Zerg Stealth Spiders, and they turned to attack the flanks on both sides of the alien army.

The Zerg Cockroaches lost their good partner, the Zerg Hydralisk, and finally showed their full combat power.

The flames they continuously sprayed alternately turned the battlefield in front into a terrifying hellfire field, and the terrifying flames of melting gold and smelting iron ignited the defensive alien soldiers one by one.

Under the attack of the Zerg Destroyer and Zerg Stealth Spider, the surviving alien ranged soldiers launched a long-range attack on the Zerg Cockroaches.

A small amount of crossbows and magic attacks had no effect on the Zerg Cockroaches, which had very strong defense and self-healing recovery capabilities.

Some of the ultra-long-range siege equipment in the 996 city of the aliens tried to attack the position of the Zerg Cockroaches.

The Zerg Hydralisk, which was not far from the Zerg Cockroaches, immediately intercepted the shells of these ultra-long-range siege equipment flying towards the position of the Zerg Cockroaches.

The Zerg cockroaches did not walk out of the Zerg Hydralisk's anti-aircraft firepower net, so the aliens wanted to use ultra-long-range firepower to attack them. First, they had to break through the Zerg Hydralisk's anti-aircraft firepower net.

It turned out that this was not easy.

With the real-time battlefield information provided by the Zerg host, the powerful Zerg Hydralisk can easily preset the anti-aircraft firepower net, and the Zerg Hydralisk can effectively intercept flying objects no matter where they fly from.

The ultra-long-range siege equipment of the aliens gave up attacking the Zerg cockroaches guarded by the Zerg Hydralisk's anti-aircraft firepower, and focused on attacking the Zerg puppies around the alien army to reduce the pressure on the alien army.

The situation outside the alien city of Jiujiuli is already difficult to reverse, and the alien army no longer sends troops out of the city.

Even if the army outside the city has the support of powerful ultra-long-range siege equipment, it is difficult to break through the defense line formed by Zerg cockroaches and Zerg stealth spiders under the auxiliary attack of Zerg destroyers and Zerg puppies.

The alien army that launched an attack on the Zerg army outside the city lost its manpower replenishment, and its offensive quickly declined, and its manpower was also rapidly reduced.

It won't take long for the elite troops of the alien army to be wiped out.

The attack of the alien army was not completely ineffective. They eliminated a large number of Zerg puppies and almost consumed all the Zerg puppies in the surrounding areas.

The Zerg puppies fought alone without the cooperation of long-range troops, and they were at a great disadvantage against the elite troops of the alien army.

In the absence of an absolute advantage in the manpower of the Zerg puppies, it was basically difficult for the Zerg puppies to break through the defensive formation of the alien army.

Of course, this has a lot to do with the fact that these Zerg puppies are just ordinary troops. The real strength of the Zerg puppies is not at the star level, and is much worse than the lowest one-star soldiers of the alien army.

The troops participating in the battle in the alien human army are basically the top one-star troops. The combat power of some one-star troops is comparable to that of two-star troops. In addition, their troops are reasonably configured and well-trained. It is very normal that the Zerg puppies that have not been upgraded cannot win.

If the Zerg puppies act together with the Zerg Hydralisk, the combat effect will be completely different.

Wu Qing is very clear about this situation, but it is really unbearable to hatch enough Zerg Hydralisks to cooperate with hundreds of millions of Zerg puppies in combat.

Hatching an ordinary Zerg Hydralisk requires 75 energy and 25 gas. When this number increases, it consumes a huge amount of resources.

"Zerg puppies are cheap and easy to use, but they become very passive when facing an army with certain strength!"

"In the future, the Zerg's activity area will become larger and larger, and the Zerg puppies urgently need a cheap partner, at least with the characteristics of cheapness and long-range air defense!"

"Queen Zerg, haven't you found a solution that meets the requirements?"

After today's battle, Wu Qing felt the weakness of the Zerg puppies more deeply.
